shape_updates.text: Example only: use the slide/shape index from template_map.json. Keep it inside the existing text box.

notes: Do not use this example's sample IDs or placeholder text as real project facts. The style sizes are targets; review overflow and preserve template geometry. Optional shape_styles apply to a whole mapped text shape/panel; use only on concise labels or intentionally highlighted panels, not entire paragraphs. Geometry remains unchanged.
